responsibility: Implements two related switch transformations in the tree middle end. The switch-conversion pass recognizes suitable GIMPLE_SWITCH statements and rewrites them into indexed loads from synthesized constructor tables or bit-test/decision-tree forms when profitable, while the switch-lowering logic builds explicit compare-and-branch decision trees for remaining switches; together they analyze case clusters, probabilities, and common successor structure, rewrite CFG and SSA, and provide the GIMPLE-side alternative to plain jump-table lowering.
same_name_distinction: Implements the executable switch-conversion and switch-lowering passes: it analyzes GIMPLE_SWITCH statements, applies table/bit-test conversions where profitable, builds decision trees for remaining cases, and rewrites CFG/SSA. Unlike gcc/tree-switch-conversion.h, which defines the cluster and support data structures used by that logic, this file runs the transformations.
